description: This file is a C header file that declares functions and includes for managing bridge modes in a network-related software component. It defines function prototypes for controlling bridge modes and managing bridge references, and includes external dependencies for specific data types.

methods.name: bridge_mode_ctrl_action
methods.description: Controls the bridge mode based on provided parameters, enabling or disabling it.

methods.name: manage_bridge
methods.description: Manages a bridge identified by a reference, enabling or disabling it, with specific mode and VLAN settings.
